messages.author: merchant
messages.text: Hi Aarav, Priya, here is the six-month retainer we discussed: website fixes, search marketing, social media and monthly reporting. It comes to ₹72,000 plus GST.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Aarav: Thanks Meera. Our vendor policy expects 15% off any retainer above ₹75,000.

messages.author: merchant
messages.text: We don't usually discount, but I'm open to talking it through. What does approval look like on your side?

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Aarav: Our ops head can approve up to ₹75,000. Anything above that goes to our MD, and that takes about three weeks.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Aarav: Our standard payment terms are net-45 from the invoice.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Aarav: We mostly need the website fixes and search marketing. Monthly reporting is nice to have, but it can wait.

messages.author: merchant
messages.text: Net-45 is hard for us, we pay our contractors at the start of every month. I can only look at a discount if you give something in return, like part of the payment on signing.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Priya: I only have ₹30,000 left in this quarter. Our fresh budget opens on 1 January.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Priya: If the total comes to ₹75,000 or less, we can pay ₹30,000 on signing and the balance in January. We would also look at a longer term if the rate is better.

messages.author: buyer
messages.text: Aarav: Sounds good. Send one clear offer when it is ready.
